final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(group_count) AS avg_count FROM group_counts) SELECT g.account_id, g.region_name, g.group_count, g.group_count - av.avg_count AS difference FROM group_counts AS g JOIN average_count AS av ON av.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
